business_summary: Suzhou TFC Optical Communication Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides optical sub-assembly integrated solutions and optoelectronic packaging manufacturing services in Mainland China and internationally. It operates through Optical Device Overall Solutions and Optoelectronic Advanced Packaging Business segments. The company offers BOX packaging technology platform/high-speed optical engine solutions; coherent optics technology platform/FAU passive sub-assembly solutions; micro-optics technology platform and product solutions; parallel optics technology platform/AOC series passive optical components solutions; passive optical components solutions for PSM/DR applications; TO packaging technology platform/high speed coaxial sub-assembly solutions; and plastic lens and fiber array solutions for SR and OBO applications. It also provides wavelength division multiplexing devices and passive module solutions; fiber optic connection solutions; WDM (AWG) alignment technology platform/MUX/De-MUX solutions; and solutions for LiDAR applications, as well as optoelectronic packaging manufacturing services for OEMs. The company's products are used in AI computing centers, data centers, optical fiber communication, and optical sensing applications. In addition, it engages in the manufacture and sale of optoelectronic devices, electric subcomponents, high-precision molds and parts, optical lenses and filters, optical wavelength division devices, and electronic components; provision of information technology consulting, software development, Internet of Things technical, trading, investment, and technology services; design, production, import, and export of automotive parts, sensor equipment, and electronic equipment; and research, development, and technical consulting for biomedical equipment. Suzhou TFC Optical Communication Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Suzhou TFC Optical Communication Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 본토 및 국제적으로 광학 하위 어셈블리 통합 솔루션 및 광전자 패키징 제조 서비스를 제공합니다. 광학 장치 전체 솔루션 및 광전자 고급 패키징 사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 BOX 패키징 기술 플랫폼/고속 광학 엔진 솔루션을 제공합니다. 코히어런트 광학 기술 플랫폼/FAU 수동 하위 조립 솔루션; 마이크로 광학 기술 플랫폼 및 제품 솔루션; 병렬 광학 기술 플랫폼/AOC 시리즈 수동 광학 부품 솔루션; PSM/DR 애플리케이션을 위한 수동 광학 부품 솔루션; TO 패키징 기술 플랫폼/고속 동축 서브어셈블리 솔루션; SR 및 OBO 애플리케이션을 위한 플라스틱 렌즈 및 파이버 어레이 솔루션을 제공합니다. 또한 파장 분할 다중화 장치 및 수동 모듈 솔루션도 제공합니다. 광섬유 연결 솔루션; WDM(AWG) 정렬 기술 플랫폼/MUX/De-MUX 솔루션; LiDAR 애플리케이션을 위한 솔루션과 OEM을 위한 광전자 패키징 제조 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사의 제품은 AI 컴퓨팅 센터, 데이터 센터에 사용됩니다.
